definitions.explanation: A ballroom dance in 3/4 time in which couples turn as they move, and the music written for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ショパン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ワルツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}いた→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I played a Chopin waltz at the recital.

examples.japanese: {舞踏会|ぶとうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧なウィンナ・ワルツ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れていた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: In the ballroom scene, a famous Viennese waltz was playing.

notes:
Used for both the dance and the music. Pieces in the style of Johann Strauss II are called ウィンナ・ワルツ (Viennese waltzes).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ワルツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧: to dance a waltz
- ワルツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play a waltz
- ワルツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧: waltz rhythm, triple time
